Definition: from G2110; to be philanthropic:--do good.
BiblicalUsage: euergetéō is the word for do good. In Acts 10:38, the text says "who went about doing good."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, euergetéō, does its job quietly — do good — and I leave it at that.
